ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is triangle ABC, A is at the lower left, C is at the lower right, and AC is the horizontal base; B is above. AB is a smooth slope. From B to C is a stair path, and beside the stairs there is a dashed line indicating the overall straight-line direction from B to C. The figure marks ∠A = 60°, ∠B = 75°. Reasoning: The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°, so ∠C = 180° - 60° - 75° = 45°. The caterpillar goes from A to B along the straight slope AB; from B to C it goes along the actual path of the stairs. Because BC and the horizontal base AC form 45° at C, the overall horizontal displacement and vertical descent of the stairs are equal. Let the horizontal displacement and vertical descent both be x, then the actual distance of the stairs is x + x = 2x, while the straight line BC = x√2, so the stair distance = √2 · BC. In triangle ABC, use the sine rule: BC / AB = sin60° / sin45° = (√3/2) / (√2/2) = √(3/2). Therefore, stair distance / AB = √2 · BC / AB = √2 · √(3/2) = √3. Final answer: √3:1

raw_record.question_text: A caterpillar crawled up a smooth slope from $A$ to $B$, and crept down the stairs from $B$ to $C$. What is the ratio of the distance the caterpillar travelled from $B$ to $C$ to the distance it travelled from $A$ to $B$?

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: A, B, C form a triangle with AC horizontal, AB a smooth slope, and the staircase from B to C follows the same overall straight descent as the dotted segment BC. The diagram marks angle A as 60° and angle B as 75°, so angle C is 45°. From the text, the caterpillar travels the straight slope distance AB, then the actual stair path from B to C. Because angle C is 45°, the total horizontal run and vertical drop of the staircase are equal, so the stair-walking distance is horizontal run plus vertical drop = sqrt(2) times the straight-line length BC. Use the sine rule in triangle ABC: BC/AB = sin60°/sin45° = sqrt(3/2). Therefore stair distance/AB = sqrt(2)·sqrt(3/2)=sqrt(3), giving the ratio sqrt(3):1.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有三角形 ABC，A 在左下，C 在右下，AC 为水平底边；B 在上方。AB 是一条光滑斜坡。由 B 到 C 是一段阶梯路径，阶梯旁有一条虚线表示从 B 到 C 的整体直线方向。图中标出 ∠A = 60°，∠B = 75°。

推理：三角形内角和为 180°，所以 ∠C = 180° - 60° - 75° = 45°。毛毛虫从 A 到 B 走的是直线斜坡 AB；从 B 到 C 走的是阶梯的实际路径。因为 BC 与水平底边 AC 在 C 处成 45°，所以阶梯整体的水平位移与竖直下降相等。设水平位移和竖直下降均为 x，则阶梯实际距离为 x + x = 2x，而直线 BC = x√2，所以阶梯距离 = √2 · BC。

在三角形 ABC 中用正弦定理：BC / AB = sin60° / sin45° = (√3/2) / (√2/2) = √(3/2)。因此，阶梯距离 / AB = √2 · BC / AB = √2 · √(3/2) = √3。

最终答案：√3:1
